QuestInfo.name: Contract with Mastema
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2151009##k, who settled down in #b#m310010000##k, has a proposition for you. #b#p2151009##k wishes to give you strength through a contract. You don't like the sound of a contract, but it does make sense. What will you do?
QuestInfo.1: Talk to #b#p2151009##k at #b#m310010000##k and accept the contract.
QuestInfo.2: You feel the power of #p2151009##k added to your own. You're still not sure about #p2151009# being in your head all the time, but #p2151009# says it's okay...

0.0: #h0#! I had a great idea. You need more battle power, right, #h0#? Well, I still have mine...it's just trapped in this cat body. I could give it to you, #h0#, if you wanted.\r\n#L0##bYou mean a contract? Interesting. But before I agree to anything... You sound different from the way I remember, #p2151009#.#l\n#k
0.1: Really? I'm not surprised. Spending hundreds of years as a little furball would change anyone. Now, are we gonna do a contract, or what?\r\n#L0##bWell...honestly, I'm rather hesitant...#l\n#k
0.2: Oh, relax. I'll grant you my demon powers, not my feline powers. You're not going to start chasing mice or anything. You'll get much stronger, and I'll be able to speak to you at any time. It's win-win! C'mon, #h0#. Let's do it!

yes.0: Excellent! I'll prepare the ritual. You...take a walk or something. Talk to me in a bit.

no.0: You sure you don't want my power? It's good power. Really good. Think it over.

1.0: Everything is ready. Let us begin the contract ritual. Focus your mind, and reach out to me...\n\n#b(You feel a strange energy flowing into you.)#k
